summary:
Main
What the previous issue flagged has happened: arrivals at Chinese ports jumped 4.41 million mt to 31.32 million last week(+16.39%), +4.8% YTD. This is the lagged delivery of the two weeks of heavy shipments that peaked at 37.4058 million mt, when Australia first cleared 20 million. Global shipments have themselves fallen back 8.02% to 34.4065 million mt with both Australia and Brazil easing - the shipment peak has passed, but the arrival peak has only just begun.
